tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Get real-time price, bid/ask, spread, and volume for a trading pair on a supported exchange

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Fetch order book depth (bids and asks) for a trading pair on a supported exchange

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description: Get recent trades for a trading pair on a supported exchange

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get account balances for all assets (or a specific asset) on a supported exchange

params.name: asset
params.description: Optional asset to filter by (e.g., USDT, BTC). Returns all assets if omitted.

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List open orders on a supported exchange, optionally filtered by trading pair symbol

params.name: symbol
params.description: Optional trading pair to filter by (e.g., BTC/USDT). Returns all if omitted.

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a new order (limit or market) on a supported exchange

params.name: side
params.description: Order side: buy or sell

params.name: type
params.description: Order type: limit or market

params.name: price
params.description: Order price (required for limit orders, ignored for market orders)

params.name: amount
params.description: Order amount in base currency

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a specific order by ID on a supported exchange

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: orderId
params.description: The order ID to cancel

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: cancel_all_orders
tools.description: Cancel all open orders for a trading pair on a supported exchange

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: get_cardano_price
tools.description: Get aggregated price for a Cardano native token from DEX liquidity pools (TOKEN/USDT via ADA bridge)

params.name: symbol
params.description: Cardano token symbol (INDY, SNEK, MIN, NIGHT)

tools.name: discover_pools
tools.description: Discover Cardano DEX liquidity pools for a native token via Iris API

params.name: symbol
params.description: Cardano token symbol (INDY, SNEK, MIN, NIGHT)

tools.name: start_grid_strategy
tools.description: Calculate and optionally place grid trading orders around the current price

params.name: dryRun
params.description: Preview grid without placing orders (default: true)

params.name: levels
params.description: Grid levels per side (default: 5)

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: spacing
params.description: Base spacing as decimal (default: 0.02 = 2%)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

params.name: orderSize
params.description: Base order size in quote currency (default: 50)

params.name: sizeModel
params.description: Size model

params.name: spacingModel
params.description: Spacing model

params.name: spacingFactor
params.description: Factor for geometric spacing (default: 1.3)

tools.name: stop_strategy
tools.description: Cancel all open orders for a trading pair, effectively stopping any running grid strategy

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken

tools.name: get_strategy_status
tools.description: Get current grid strategy status: open orders, current price, and P&L estimate

params.name: symbol
params.description: Trading pair symbol (e.g., BTC/USDT, INDY/USDT)

params.name: exchange
params.description: Exchange to query. Supported: mexc, gateio, bitget, kraken
